Name: Clint Reforged
Author: SoftPandaBoi
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/18345/18345-1695335897-292712533.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
In November of 2021, I posted my first "big" mod. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10048]Improved Clint[/url], at the time, it was pretty good! Especially for a first attempt, however, over time I saw more and more mistakes in it that kept important things from happening and working. After the last update to that mod, I thought it would be a good idea to remake it from scratch... And, well, here we are! I took what worked from my original mod and mixed it with a lot of new stuff to make this mod!

Current Features:
[list]
[*]An Improved Character Arc
[*]6 New Events
[*]Can be Romanced
[*]Custom Spouse Room and Spouse Patio
[*]Optional Tweaked Portraits/Sprites that Improve on the Original Ones
[*]Option Between Goatee and Shaved for the Tweaked Portraits/Sprites
[*]Dynamic Changes to Other Events and Dialogue depending on his Character Arc
[*]A Lot More Dialogue than in Vanilla
[*]Compatibility with [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿
[/list]

Planned Features:
[list]
[*]Seasonal Outfits with Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve Outfits for the Tweaked Portraits/Sprites (Portraits are already mostly done.)
[*]Make the Events a Bit Longer
[*]More Dialogue
[*]More Marriage Dialogue
[*]Remake Some of the Old Events from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10048]Improved Clint[/url] that Weren't Included
[/list]
TW: Includes mentions/references to suicide.

Mods that modify/replace Clint's Portrait and/or Sprite probably won't be compatible as this one adds new sprites and portraits. They won't break or anything, but you might get small visual glitches. Mods that change Emily's and Shane's events might have similar compatibility issues. If you have any questions, post it in the comments!

Downloads.Description: Updated to fix an error in the 7 Heart Event pt. 2 (Thanks to Joshiyoshi1425!) and 10 Heart event! If you had to skip the events but would like to watch them, use the console commands "debug ebi 183450008" (7 pt. 2) and/or "debug ebi 183450" (10).
